blurb: Guests rent personal watercraft, pontoon boats, and ski boats to explore Lake Powell and its side canyons. Rentals include options for delivery to Stateline Boat Ramp or pickup at the office in Page, AZ. Multi-day discounts and free accessories with multi-day reservations are available.
extraNote: Security deposit $750 per jet ski, $1000 per boat, held on card and released if no damage · Gas not included; must return with full tank or pay for refueling deducted from deposit · 680 Haul Road, Page, Arizona, 86040 or delivery to Stateline Boat Ramp, Page, AZ 86040 · March 1st to November 15th
